name: megadj
description: Rate-limited YouTube Music library archiver with rekordbox-ready metadata — GetDat (acquire), FullTags (enrich), CrateDeck (USB drives)

scripts.typecheck:py: uv run --no-sync mypy cratedeck/python/rb_read.py cratedeck/python/usb_tree.py tools/rb_art.py
scripts.lint: oxlint --deny-warnings src fulltags tools cratedeck/src cratedeck/shared cratedeck/web cratedeck/test
scripts.lint:py: uv run --no-sync ruff check cratedeck/python tools
scripts.format:check: prettier --cache --cache-location node_modules/.cache/prettier-cache --cache-strategy content --check src tools fulltags cratedeck/src cratedeck/shared cratedeck/web cratedeck/test knip.json .oxlintrc.json plugin
scripts.format: prettier --cache --cache-location node_modules/.cache/prettier-cache --cache-strategy content --write src tools fulltags cratedeck/src cratedeck/shared cratedeck/web cratedeck/test knip.json .oxlintrc.json plugin
scripts.check: f=0; bun run typecheck & a=$!; bun run lint & b=$!; bun run format:check & c=$!; bun run knip & d=$!; bun run web:build & e=$!; for p in $a $b $c $d $e; do wait $p || f=1; done; exit $f
scripts.check:full: f=0; (bun run typecheck && bun run knip) & a=$!; (bun run lint && bun run format:check) & b=$!; bun test --parallel=16 & c=$!; bun run typecov & d=$!; bun run lint:py & e=$!; bun run typecheck:py & g=$!; bun run web:build & h=$!; for p in $a $b $c $d $e $g $h; do wait $p || f=1; done; exit $f
scripts.check:watch: tsc --noEmit --watch --pretty false & bun --watch run lint & wait
